title: Transit Innovation Fleet Grant
description: Supports nonprofits purchasing or leasing passenger vans to expand community shuttle services. Funds cover vehicles, adaptive equipment, driver training, and insurance.
eligibility_bullets: Applicant operates at least one year of transportation services
Vehicle must meet ADA accessibility requirements

title: Community Pantry Equipment Fund
description: Provides cold storage equipment for food pantries, shelters, or nutrition hubs expanding perishable food distribution.
eligibility_bullets: Must document increase in fresh food distribution capacity
Provide floor plan showing electrical requirements
Upload food safety certification for staff

title: Digital Bridge Student Device Grant
description: Funds laptops or tablets for students participating in out-of-school tutoring, college access, or workforce readiness programs.
eligibility_bullets: Program must serve at least 25 students annually
Provide device distribution and accountability plan
At least 50% of students qualify for free/reduced lunch

title: National Accessible Vehicle Challenge
description: Awards nonprofits modernizing fleets with wheelchair-accessible vehicles or retrofitting vans with ramps and securement systems.
eligibility_bullets: Organization must provide proof of insurance and maintenance plan
Vehicle must be placed into service within 6 months
